title: Read the quarterly ranking evidence surfaces from their owners on deployed dev

ac_1_owner_reads_no_bff_cache.detail: Each of the seven ranking evidence surfaces (evidence_refs, knowledge_evidence, capability_snapshots, persona_bindings, runtime_bindings, telemetry_summaries, persona_sessions) is read from its existing owner through the existing owner read path in default BFF composition (compose_bff_app()); none is served from a BFF copy or cache.

ac_2_reachable_empty_ok_unavailable_dist.detail: Reachable owners with 0 records report status='ok' and items=[]; unreachable/failing owners report status='unavailable' with source='unavailable'; source='missing' is reserved strictly for unconfigured owners.

ac_3_default_composition_evaluator_unblo.detail: With default composition and reachable owners, GET /bff/management/quarterly-ranking reports all surfaces as ok and quarterly_ranking status as ok, allowing the persona evaluator to admit ranking evidence; failing owner degrades the ranking and evaluator.

ac_4_tenant_scoping_and_evidence_redacti.detail: Tenant scoping filters records by caller tenant_id; cross-tenant records are strictly isolated. Evidence redaction via models.redact_evidence_refs remains intact with 32/32 tests passing in test_evidence_redaction_fail_closed.py.

ac_5_mounted_default_composition_tests.detail: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ranking_evidence_surfaces_default_composition.py covers ok-empty, ok-populated, owner-down, and cross-tenant scenarios.

ac_6_line_budget_compliance.detail: Net production line growth is +75 lines, complying with the net_prod_line_budget limit of <= 80 lines.
